title: Josetta's Hashbrown Casserole Recipe
ingredients: 1 (32-ounce) package frozen diced hash brown potatoes, thawed
directions: Preheat the oven to 350˚F. Stir together the first 5 ingredients and 1/2 cup of the butter until well blended. Spoon into a greased 2- to 3-quart baking dish.
Crush the cereal, and stir in the remaining 1/4 cup butter. Sprinkle over the potato mixture.
